name: b.i.t. Bremerhaven IT-Haven
notes: Municipal IT provider b.i.t. Bremerhaven states that it operates data centers/IT-Haven for municipal and private-sector customers; no power capacity disclosed.

name: Datacon Bremerhaven Rechenzentrum
notes: Datacon's Bremerhaven page offers hosted virtual server environments in its data center; no capacity disclosed.

name: Alfred Wegener Institute AWI Rechen- und Datenzentrum
notes: AWI's Bremerhaven computing/data center supports scientific computing and information systems; no power capacity disclosed.

name: Portus Data Centers IPHH4 Hamburg
notes: New IPHH4 facility at the Internet Port Hamburg Wendenstrasse campus; Portus says phase 1 construction starts Q1 2025 and completes Q4 2026, with total IT load of 12.8 MW.

name: Penta Infra HAM01 Hamburg
notes: Trade press reports Penta Infra launched HAM01 in Hamburg with 4.4 MW across 2,500 sqm of white space after a late-2023 groundbreaking.

name: Equinix HH1 Hamburg IBX
notes: Equinix lists HH1 at Vierenkamp 1, Hamburg; capacity listed by area rather than MW.

name: University of Hamburg Regional Computing Center renovation
notes: University announced renovation/repair of its Regional Computing Center after structural damage; RRZ remains the university computing center.

name: BADEN CLOUD Rechenzentrum Heppenheim
notes: Provider advertises a high-availability cloud/data center in Heppenheim, Landkreis Bergstraße; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: GSI/FAIR Green IT Cube
notes: Scientific HPC data center on the GSI/FAIR campus in Darmstadt; GSI states 8 MW cooling capacity in expansion stages 1-2, rising to 12 MW in final phase.

name: DARZ Darmstadt Data Center
notes: DARZ lists a Darmstadt data center with 8,000 sqm total floor space and 2,400 sqm IT space for up to 1,000 racks; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: STACK Infrastructure Babenhausen hyperscale campus
notes: Planned EUR 3bn hyperscale project near Babenhausen was cancelled/withdrawn amid planning uncertainty and local-government support issues; no MW capacity found.

name: Digital Realty FRA18 Frankfurt
notes: FRA18 at Digital Park Fechenheim / Hanauer Landstrasse 360 opened with 8,200 sqm colocation space and 16 MW total IT capacity.

name: Digital Realty FRA20 Frankfurt
notes: Digital Realty announced start of construction for FRA20 at Digital Park Fechenheim; source confirms project but did not disclose MW in accessible text.

name: CyrusOne FRA7 Frankfurt Westside
notes: CyrusOne FRA7 at Frankfurt Westside in Griesheim is planned to deliver 81 MW IT capacity across two buildings/nine data halls; first 9 MW phase targeted for Q2 2026.

name: Colt DCS Frankfurt West
notes: Colt DCS lists its Frankfurt West hyperscale data center in Sossenheim with 25 MW IT load and 10,000 sqm technical area.

name: Iron Mountain FRA-1 and FRA-2 Frankfurt
notes: Iron Mountain lists FRA-1 as a 27 MW greenfield Frankfurt facility and FRA-2 as 10.6 MW, for 37.6 MW total Frankfurt capacity.

name: NETHINKS Housing ITZ Fulda
notes: Aggregator listings identify NETHINKS Fulda at Am Alten Schlachthof 4 as a colocation data center; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Stadt Fulda municipal Rechenzentrum
notes: City of Fulda states uploaded/intermediate data for its ZendTo service is stored on devices operated in the city administration's own data center.

name: Hochschule Fulda Data Center
notes: Fulda University of Applied Sciences lists its Data Center as a central university administration/IT unit; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Gießen Katzenfeld data center
developer: City of Gießen / undisclosed project proponent
notes: Revised development plan in Gießen's Weststadt/Katzenfeld area was re-opened for public display; reports cite 65 MW connected load, up to 900 jobs, and waste-heat use.

name: Data Center Group / Sommerlad Wettenberg data center
developer: Data Center Group GmbH and Sommerlad
notes: Wettenberg in Landkreis Gießen; proposed roughly 30,000 sqm site next to Sommerlad central warehouse with data center, office building, battery storage, and PV; MW not disclosed in initial reports.

name: Justus Liebig University Gießen Hochschulrechenzentrum
notes: University source documents the Hochschulrechenzentrum / central computing center history and role; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Vantage Frankfurt II (FRA2) Raunheim campus
notes: Vantage lists the Frankfurt II campus in Raunheim, Landkreis Groß-Gerau, with 56 MW critical IT load when fully developed; 2022 announcement said first 40 MW facility opened.

name: NTT Frankfurt 3 Rüsselsheim
notes: NTT lists Frankfurt 3 in Rüsselsheim, Landkreis Groß-Gerau, with 28,300+ sqm server space and 60.5 MW IT load.

name: Vantage Groß-Gerau FRA5 / Lausboehl campus proposal
notes: Groß-Gerau city council voted against contract negotiations for Vantage's proposed 174 MW campus; reports describe a EUR 2.5bn project in/near the Lausboehl industrial park.

name: AZV Hersfeld-Rotenburg modular IT-Safe data center
notes: Prior1 describes delivering a fully operational modular IT-Safe data center/technology room for AZV Hersfeld-Rotenburg in a wooded area of Bad Hersfeld; no MW capacity disclosed.
